recommendations.concert_met_nt_live: exclude from Special Events — event cinema / Special Presentations
recommendations.anniversary_events: exclude unless explicit opening-night / Q&A / fan-event wording
recommendations.premieres: publish when premiere event / opening night wording is explicit
